data: You summon a whirlwind of jagged branches and razor sharp leaves that batter all creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. All creatures caught in the flurry must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.
Startles all other Pokémon. User cannot act in the next turn.
All Pokemon must make a CHA Saving Throw against your Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
